title: KNS Simulation Configuration v1
description: Effective inputs recorded by the headless batch runner for a single simulation.

engine_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the selected KNS executable at batch start.

topology_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original bytes copied into the topology snapshot used by KNS.

topology_snapshot.description: Portable path to the recorded snapshot, relative to the enclosing result file.

seed.description: Unsigned 64-bit seed encoded as 16 lowercase hexadecimal digits. Convert to decimal for the KNS CLI.

auto_start.description: Whether KNS generated the default traffic workload.

link_events.description: Exact CLI arguments in scheduling order. Each is time_seconds:node_a:node_b:down|up and is validated semantically by KNS.
